title: Static equilibrium distance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the distance from O to the stationary ring as 0.05 m.

title: Angular velocity at original length
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the angular velocity when the spring is at its original length, expressed as a numerical value or simplified radical.

title: Angular velocity at point P
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the angular velocity when the ring is at point P as 10 rad/s.

title: Force balance application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply force balance in the vertical direction for the ring in uniform circular motion.

title: Centripetal force formulation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly set up Newton's second law for circular motion in the horizontal plane.

title: Geometry of rotation radius
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly relate the ring's position along the rod to its radius of circular motion using the sine of angle α.

title: Hooke's Law application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Hooke's Law to find the spring force or compression for different configurations.

title: Sign or force direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student makes an error in the sign or direction of the spring force, normal force, or gravitational components.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student's work demonstrates consistent use of SI units throughout the calculation.
